kurals.tr: Nizhalneerum Innaadha Innaa Thamarneerum / Innaavaam Innaa Seyin
kurals.m: Shade and water are not pleasant, (if) they cause disease; so are the qualities of (one's) relations not agreeable, (if) they cause pain

kurals.tr: Vaalpola Pakaivarai Anjarka Anjuka / Kelpol Pakaivar Thotarpu
kurals.m: Fear not foes (who say they would cut) like a sword; (but) fear the friendship of foes (who seemingly

kurals.tr: Utpakai Anjiththar Kaakka Ulaivitaththu / Matpakaiyin Maanath Therum
kurals.m: Fear internal enmity and guard yourself; (if not) it will destroy (you) in an evil hour, as surely as the tool which cuts the potter's clay

kurals.tr: Manamaanaa Utpakai Thondrin Inamaanaa / Edham Palavum Tharum
kurals.m: The secret enmity of a person whose mind in unreformed will lead to many evils causing disaffection among (one's) relations

kurals.tr: Uralmuraiyaan Utpakai Thondrin Iralmuraiyaan / Edham Palavum Tharum
kurals.m: If there appears internal hatred in a (king's) family; it will lead to many a fatal crime

kurals.tr: Ondraamai Ondriyaar Katpatin Egngnaandrum / Pondraamai Ondral Aridhu
kurals.m: If hatred arises among (one's) own people, it will be hardly possible (for one) to escape death

kurals.tr: Seppin Punarchchipol Kootinum Kootaadhe / Utpakai Utra Kuti
kurals.m: Never indeed will a family subject to internal hatred unite (really) though it may present an apparent union like that of a casket and its lid

kurals.tr: Aramporudha Ponpolath Theyum Uramporudhu / Utpakai Utra Kuti
kurals.m: A family subject to internal hatred will wear out and lose its strength like iron that has been filed away

kurals.tr: Etpaka Vanna Sirumaiththe Aayinum / Utpakai Ulladhaang Ketu
kurals.m: Although internal hatred be as small as the fragment of the sesamum (seed), still does destruction dwell in it

kurals.tr: Utampaatu Ilaadhavar Vaazhkkai Kutangarul / Paampotu Utanurain Thatru
kurals.m: Living with those who do not agree (with one) is like dwelling with a cobra (in the same) hut
